summary: Rename the site to “Study Vibe” and extend the Class 9 single-page subject summaries site by adding illustrative images for each subject and providing Hindi translations for all subjects/content.

existing_features.title: Single-page “Study Vibes Class 9” subject summary site
existing_features.description: Renders a single-page website titled “Study Vibes Class 9” that displays seven subject summaries sourced from a typed content module and shown as individual sections/cards.

existing_features.title: Responsive multi-column subject card layout
existing_features.description: Displays subject sections in a responsive grid (single column on small screens, multi-column on larger breakpoints) with spacing and typography intended for readability.

existing_features.title: Sticky header with branding and static generated images
existing_features.description: Implements a sticky header with a logo and site title plus a hero banner image loaded from static frontend assets under /assets/generated (no backend image routing).

existing_features.title: Quick-jump subject navigation with smooth scrolling
existing_features.description: Provides a horizontally scrollable subject menu that scrolls smoothly to the corresponding subject section using element IDs.

existing_features.title: Warm academic visual theme via design tokens
existing_features.description: Defines a cohesive warm (non blue/purple) color palette and typography styling via CSS variables consumed by Tailwind, including light and dark token sets.

existing_features.title: Readable long-form content rendering
existing_features.description: Renders subject content with paragraph splitting on double newlines and applies prose/typography styles for better long-text readability.

existing_features.title: App bootstrapping with React Query and Internet Identity provider
existing_features.description: Bootstraps the app with a global React Query client/provider and wraps the component tree in an Internet Identity context provider for identity availability across reloads.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication and ICP actor creation hooks (infrastructure)
existing_features.description: Includes hooks to manage Internet Identity login/logout and to create an authenticated or anonymous backend actor instance that reacts to identity changes (intended for ICP canister calls).

existing_features.title: Rename the app/site branding from “Study Vibes Class 9” to “Study Vibe” across all user-visible UI and page metadata (including the header title in the React UI and the HTML document title).

Add Hindi translations for all subject titles and subject summary content, and provide a UI control to switch the displayed language between English and Hindi for the entire page (navigation labels, subject card titles, and subject content).

Add a subject-specific illustrative image for each subject (Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Hindi, Sanskrit, Computer Application, English) and display it in the UI within each subject card in a consistent, responsive layout.
Update existing generated branding images to align with the renamed app “Study Vibe”, and ensure the UI continues to reference the correct static asset filenames under /assets/generated/.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add illustrative images/icons for each subject section (Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Hindi, Sanskrit, Computer Application, English) and display them in the UI.
Provide Hindi translation for all subjects/content (add Hindi versions of the subject summaries and expose them in the UI).
Change site/app name from “Study Vibes Class 9” to “Study Vibe” across UI branding and metadata.

architectural_notes: Frontend is a React SPA (Vite-style entry) with TailwindCSS and Tailwind Typography for readable long-form text styling.
Content is modeled as a typed data module (class9Summaries.ts) and rendered declaratively by mapping over the array.
UI structure uses sticky header + sticky sub-navigation to improve usability on long pages.
Theme is implemented via CSS variables (OKLCH) wired into Tailwind config, enabling consistent light/dark palettes through design tokens.
Static images are expected to be served directly from the frontend public path (/assets/generated/...) rather than via the backend.
React Query is included as an application-wide provider to support cached async data flows.
Internet Identity is implemented as a React context provider (AuthClient) for persistent identity across reloads.
ICP canister interaction is abstracted behind an actor-creation hook (useActor) that recreates the actor based on the current identity.
known_issues: The backend canister (backend/main.mo) defines an empty actor with no methods; the app is currently purely static content.
Authentication is implemented (Internet Identity provider and hooks) but there is no UI to trigger login/logout, and no app features currently depend on identity.
The code references generated image assets under /assets/generated/, but the actual image files are not present in the provided file listing (may be missing from repo or not included here).

There appear to be duplicate/conflicting global CSS theme files in the provided listing (frontend/index.css vs frontend/src/index.css) with different token sets; this can cause confusion about which theme is active in builds.
Dark mode variables exist (Tailwind darkMode: 'class') but there is no in-app mechanism to toggle the dark class.
Internet Identity configuration depends on environment (process.env.II_URL) and config loading; misconfiguration will break login.
useActor invalidates/refetches all non-actor React Query queries whenever the actor changes, which can be unnecessarily expensive for larger apps.
No automated tests are present in the provided codebase.
